mutate_comment: orders-repo.ts is covered only by the integration lane, which vitest.config.ts excludes. Scoring it here publishes a 0.00% that reads as 'untested' when the truth is the opposite. It has its own config: npm run test:mutation:integration
ignorePatterns_comment: Keep generated artifacts out of the sandbox. Stryker copies the project file by file, so a concurrent Playwright run rewriting test-results/ crashes the copy with ENOENT. None of these are inputs to mutation testing.
